style: Use case: illustration-story / scientific-educational. ONE children's science picture book illustration, landscape aspect 1216:832. Warm watercolor and colored pencils on fine cream paper, friendly refined rounded shapes, clear educational detail and believable construction, age 4-8. No text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks or panel borders. Leave important objects comfortably inside margins. No baked-in arrows; all labels and arrows are added separately by the website.
scenes: Cover: beautiful continuous ocean cutaway panorama, sunlit turquoise surface with small waves at top, colorful coral fish and turtle near upper-left, tall kelp near upper-right, middle blue deep water with whale shark and jellyfish, bottom dark indigo trench with tiny glowing deep-sea creatures. Educational vertical depth overview, not a mixed aquarium, large clear water areas separating habitats.

Sunlight zone: split waterline scene, warm sun in sky upper-left, sparkling gentle wave surface across upper third, clear turquoise underwater light rays reaching school of silver and yellow reef fish at center-lower. Sandy shallows softly visible. Emphasize sun, surface wave, fish; no abyssal animals.

Coral reef close underwater view in clear sunlit shallow water: orange-white clownfish at left near sea anemone, green sea turtle gracefully swimming upper-right with exactly four flippers, colorful branching and mound corals at bottom and center. Natural animal faces, no human smiles, rich but not crowded habitat.

Kelp forest underwater looking upward: tall olive-green kelp fronds rise from rocky holdfasts at seabed to surface, rippling soft light. A large enough anatomically recognizable seahorse foreground left, snout and curled prehensile tail clearly WRAPPED around a kelp stalk. No legs, no horse hooves, no coral dominating kelp.

Twilight zone: gentle spotted whale shark swimming horizontally center-left in dim cobalt water, broad flattened head and wide mouth, white spots and gill slits, shark vertical tail. Several translucent softly glowing jellyfish at right. Faint blue light from above fading into darkness below, NO colorful shallow coral or bright sun disc.

Deep anglerfish closeup on nearly dark navy water: round small brown deep-sea fish facing right, natural fins, a SINGLE thin flexible stalk extends forward from forehead to a small luminous cream lure. The lure clearly separated above in front of fish's face. Friendly but biologically recognizable toothed mouth not threatening, no human limbs or silly costume.

Midnight zone: almost black indigo water, one luminous translucent jellyfish upper-left with bell and trailing tentacles; one squid center-right with elongated mantle, paired fins and trailing arms, delicate rows of bioluminescent dots. Animals emit local cyan-violet glow only. No sunlight shafts, no divers, no shallow reef.

Abyssal seafloor closeup: dark blue cold soft sediment with an elongated soft bumpy SEA CUCUMBER crawling foreground-left and cluster of white tubes with red feathery tubeworm plumes emerging near rocks at right. Local soft cool illustrative illumination, navy water behind. No grass, seaweed, daylight or fish with human features.

Hydrothermal vent seafloor scene: dark rocky chimney central-left emits dark mineral-rich cloudy plume into cold deep water, plume not volcanic fire. Pale vent crabs with realistic claws and walking legs cluster on rocks right. Subtle suspended particles and a few small bubbles acceptable, no ocean boiling at surface, no sunlight, no lava fountain.

Very deep ocean trench: dramatic dark V-shaped seafloor valley receding into indigo distance. Foreground small pale translucent pink-white snailfish with soft tadpole-like body, small fins and rounded head, swims just above sediment near center-right. No snail shell, no giant teeth, no scuba diver, no sunlight, no surface coral. Creature clearly visible through localized artistic soft light.

Coastal conservation scene: child with adult on clean beach at left using litter grabber and reusable collection bag, a few safe plastic bottles picked up away from water. Vast healthy blue ocean occupies center-right, distant fishing boat and seabirds subtle. Child fully on beach supervised, no underwater breathing, no slogans or arrows. Hopeful calm future.

Ocean recap as one continuous vertical underwater landscape: light turquoise surface top, reef and kelp upper zone, whale shark and jellyfish mid-depth, anglerfish deeper, sea cucumber and vent near bottom, deep trench recedes at lower-right. Clear stylized depth gradient, subjects separated into correct zones, no panel borders, no labels or arrows.
